symptom: LVS mismatch: missing, shorted, or open nets

first_checks.check: Verify net exists in both schematic and layout databases
first_checks.why_first: rules out missing net in one domain

first_checks.check: Visual inspection of reported location in layout viewer
first_checks.why_first: cheapest confirmation of real vs false positive

first_checks.check: Re-run LVS with different extraction seeds
first_checks.why_first: rules out merge artefacts from parallel processing

first_checks.check: Review extraction deck layer mappings for suspect layers

discriminating_experiments.experiment: Run LVS with single-threaded extraction (disable parallel runs)
discriminating_experiments.rules_in: Short disappears → merge artefact from parallel processing
discriminating_experiments.rules_out: Short persists → real short in layout

discriminating_experiments.experiment: Run LVS with selective layer extraction (exclude one layer at a time)
discriminating_experiments.rules_in: Short disappears when a specific layer is excluded → extraction deck error for that layer
discriminating_experiments.rules_out: Short persists across all layer combinations → real connectivity issue

discriminating_experiments.experiment: Create minimal layout with only the problematic net and its neighbors
discriminating_experiments.rules_in: Short disappears in isolation → interaction effect with distant geometry
discriminating_experiments.rules_out: Short persists in isolation → fundamental connectivity error

discriminating_experiments.experiment: Run LVS with a different extraction tool or version
discriminating_experiments.rules_in: Short disappears with different tool → tool-specific bug or limitation
discriminating_experiments.rules_out: Short persists across tools → real layout issue

common_root_causes.cause: Missing via or metal gap causing open net
Accidental metal merge causing short (e.g., overlapping shapes)
Extraction deck layer misconfiguration (wrong layer type or connectivity)
LVS tool false positive due to complex geometry (e.g., jagged edges, dense routing)
Design rule violation causing extraction failure (e.g., minimum spacing not met)

classic_trap: Assuming a reported short is a real layout error when it is actually a tool artefact from parallel extraction or complex geometry handling
node_era_note: 7nm-and-below: more false shorts/opens from complex multi-patterning and finFET extraction rules

symptom: LVS mismatch: wrong device sizes or extra devices

first_checks.check: Verify device parameters (W/L, fingers) in LVS report
Compare schematic symbol cell reference vs layout cell reference
first_checks.why_first: rules out library cell reference errors

first_checks.check: Check if device is in a parameterized block (memory, repeated logic)
Verify library mapping between schematic and layout databases

discriminating_experiments.experiment: Run LVS with alternative library mapping file
discriminating_experiments.rules_in: Size mismatch disappears → library mapping error
discriminating_experiments.rules_out: Size mismatch persists → real device size difference

discriminating_experiments.experiment: Directly compare device properties (W, L, fingers, type) in layout vs schematic
discriminating_experiments.rules_in: Properties differ → actual layout modification or wrong cell
discriminating_experiments.rules_out: Properties match in both → LVS tool misinterpretation

discriminating_experiments.experiment: Run LVS on a minimal testcase with only the problematic device
discriminating_experiments.rules_in: Mismatch disappears in isolation → interaction with other devices or hierarchy
discriminating_experiments.rules_out: Mismatch persists in isolation → fundamental device property error

discriminating_experiments.experiment: Check if mismatch is consistent across all instances of the device
discriminating_experiments.rules_in: Mismatch consistent across all → parameterized cell issue
discriminating_experiments.rules_out: Mismatch unique to one instance → manual editing or local error

common_root_causes.cause: Wrong cell reference in layout (using different variant of the same logical cell)
Parameterized cell instantiated with incorrect parameters
Library version mismatch between schematic and layout
Manual layout editing changing device size or adding extra device
LVS tool misinterpreting device geometry (e.g., fin counting error)

classic_trap: Assuming a device size mismatch is a layout error when it is actually a library mapping or parameterization issue
node_era_note: 7nm-and-below: more parameterized cells and complex library structures increase frequency of mapping errors
